about: Big Red Racing DOS patch (Phase 3b): our compiled code (src/dospatch/, built by 'python3 brr.py dos-build'), where it goes, and the sites it changes in the player's own RACING.EXE v2.24. Checksums only: no game bytes. Read by dos_patch.py.

sites.name: race_enter
sites.about: main, the race screen: MOV EAX,race_enter -> brr_race_enter (resets the interpolation; the logging build's seed), which calls race_enter

sites.name: race_tick
sites.about: MOV EDX,race_tick -> brr_race_tick: calls race_tick, then snapshots the vehicles

sites.name: race_draw
sites.about: MOV EBX,race_draw -> brr_race_draw: writes the blended state, draws, puts the true state back

sites.name: race_leave
sites.about: MOV ECX,race_leave -> brr_race_leave (the logging build flushes its files)

sites.name: race_tick_compare
sites.about: run_screen's PrtSc check: CMP EDI,race_tick -> brr_race_tick, so the race screenshot routine is still chosen

sites.name: preview_tick
sites.about: main, the track preview (screen 0x10, track select's View: a helicopter flyover on the level's 6.REC): MOV EDX,0x132BC (its tick) -> brr_preview_tick: calls it, then snapshots the vehicles

sites.name: preview_draw
sites.about: MOV EBX,0x13318 (its draw) -> brr_preview_draw: writes the blended state, draws, puts the true state back

sites.name: camera_update_call
sites.about: render_view: CALL camera_update -> CALL brr_camera_update (calls it, then fine angles and the roll fix, for drawing only)

sites.name: frame_start
sites.about: run_screen: CMP AL,35; JBE +7; MOV byte [frame_ticks],35 -> CALL brr_cap; NOP x6: brr_frame_start caps the ticks (35, or the lower cap on a fast machine) and keeps the average ticks per frame that decides whether the machine is fast

sites.name: approach_clamped
sites.about: approach_clamped: MOV AL,[frame_ticks] -> MOV AL,1; NOP x3 (one step per tick, as in Phase 3a; reached from the race tick, changed on purpose: the camera only)

sites.name: camera_mode4_previous
sites.about: camera_mode4: MOV AX,[ESI+10h]; MOV word [ESI+24h],0; MOV [ESI+46h],AX -> MOV word [ESI+24h],0; CALL brr_cam4; NOP x3 ('previous' yaw only when a tick ran)

sites.name: rotation_entry
sites.about: rotation_matrix's first 5 bytes (PUSH EDI; PUSH ESI; SHR EAX,5) -> JMP brr_hook_rotation (drawing only, not reachable from the race tick)

sites.name: present_call
sites.about: the present (every single-view screen): CALL copy_frame -> CALL brr_present (waits for the vertical retrace, then copies)

sites.name: present_split_call
sites.about: the split-screen present: CALL copy_frame_split -> CALL brr_present_split

sites.name: version_text
sites.about: main menu, "%s%s %s": PUSH the date -> PUSH brr_tag ("F0.1 CIARV": the version and the fixes chosen)

sites.name: version_number
sites.about: main menu's version number (pushed at 0x31BDF): "V2.24" -> "V2.25", the installed patch (director, 2026-11-10; the network version string at 0x70F80 stays)

sites.name: credit_lookup_call
sites.about: the main menu's credits ticker (0x2E8D4): CALL 0x25D5C (the language text lookup of "CRED_<n>", n from 0x731A8) -> CALL brr_credit_lookup: at step 2 our own line ("Camera fix by ctrl-alt-rees", director 2026-11-14), after it CRED_<n-1>

sites.name: scn_commit_call
sites.about: scn_load (0x29350, a screen's .SCN script): CALL menu_hotspot_commit (0x25B68) -> CALL brr_scn_commit: the commit, then a key hotspot for Esc or left or right is noted for a twin on joystick 1's button 2 (0x74) or stick (0x77, 0x78); not on the keys (0x0E) or joystick (0x17) screens (director, 2026-11-15)

sites.name: scn_end_call
sites.about: scn_load's last call, CALL menu_background_save (0x2D774) -> CALL brr_scn_end: the noted twins added after the script's own hotspots, then menu_background_save

sites.name: credit_count
sites.about: the credits ticker's MOV EBX,0x1C (the counter wraps at 28 lines) -> MOV EBX,0x1D: 29 steps, the game's 28 lines and ours

protected_about: Game functions the race tick reaches (direct calls, Phase 2 call graph), except approach_clamped, which is patched on purpose. They must be byte-for-byte unchanged, fixups too.
